_doc: Named active windows. Routines reference these by name in their trigger.active_window field. Inline windows are also supported when a window is one-off.

sleep._doc: Overnight window. Bed-facing camera + light dim + nest cooldown all run inside this.

work_hours._doc: Standard weekday work block. Email checks, focus reminders, posture nudges live here.

morning._doc: Morning briefing / coffee nudge / overnight news roundup window.

daytime._doc: General awake hours. Default for things that should NOT fire while you sleep.
